subject.title: [Feature]: Support sessionKey-based concurrency guard for webhook       deliveries

question: Should same-session hook-agent deliveries be rejected, skipped, queued, or left accepted by default, and should non-parallel behavior be opt-in per hook or mapping?
rationale: The requested behavior changes public webhook response semantics and retry behavior, while adjacent persistent-session and queue work create product choices that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Opt-In Overlap Policy
options.body: Keep existing 200/default behavior and add a documented hook or mapping policy for reject, skip, or queue behavior keyed by resolved sessionKey.

options.title: Make 409 The Default
options.body: Reject active same-session hook deliveries by default and accept that existing integrations may need migration to avoid retry storms.

options.title: Leave Locking To Callers
options.body: Keep hook delivery accepted-by-default and document idempotency keys plus caller-managed locks as the supported overlap control.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Overlap Policy
recommendation.body: Keep existing 200/default behavior and add a documented hook or mapping policy for reject, skip, or queue behavior keyed by resolved sessionKey.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a Gateway hook API and compatibility policy decision, and steipete has recent adjacent hook/session product history.
